title: Gallery Fog / Caffeinated Melon
summary: Espresso-hooked melon emits honesty fog. Ninety seconds of truth. Then everyone pretends. Justine eats crackers.
visualArc: White cube → melon + tubes → fog → frozen confessions → clap.
